explication: This Terraform module provisions an Amazon MWAA environment from caller-supplied settings and network identifiers. The principal workflow is configuration input, creation or reuse of supporting AWS resources, and deployment of the managed Airflow environment; DAGs are stored in S3 at the configured path. The README documents optional customer-owned IAM, S3, and security-group resources, logging, and Airflow configuration. Source excerpts were unavailable, so relationships are limited to those documented in the README; individual resource-to-resource wiring is not shown.
